scope: One bounded immutable-source capture batch, at most seven cases per engine, sequential descendant-safe wrappers, approved runVerifiedScene only. Copy exact remotely published author v2 bytes, create separate v2 harness, no engine/author/frozen-v1 changes. Stop remaining cases for a failed engine, continue independent engine. No cleanup deletion or new worker.
script:
import json,subprocess,os,sys,hashlib,shutil
from pathlib import Path
repo=Path.cwd();base=repo/'benchmarks/cottage-comparison-20261002'
for engine in ('a','b'):
 source=Path('/workspace/scratch/0190a8c72f8a/aperture-cottage-author-'+engine+'-20261002/v2')
 dest=base/'sources'/ (engine+'-v2');dest.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
 for p in source.iterdir():
  if not p.is_file() or p.is_symlink():raise RuntimeError('Unexpected author output')
  data=p.read_bytes()
  assert subprocess.check_output(['git','show','origin/main:'+str((dest/p.name).relative_to(repo))])==data
  (dest/p.name).write_bytes(data)
driver=(base/'run.mjs').read_text()
driver=driver.replace('[engine,attempt,view="front",edit="base"]','[engine,attempt,view="front",edit="base",version="v2"]')
driver=driver.replace('m[1]+"-v1"','m[1]+"-"+version')
driver=driver.replace('await mkdir(out,{recursive:true})','await mkdir(out,{recursive:false})')
driver=driver.replace('scene:report.sceneStatus','scene:{ok:report.sceneStatus.ok,view:report.sceneStatus.view,edit:report.sceneStatus.edit}')
(base/'run-v2.mjs').write_text(driver)
subprocess.run(['node','--check',str(base/'run-v2.mjs')],check=True)
cases=[('front','base'),('rear','base'),('side','base'),('front','roof'),('front','bench'),('front','trees'),('rear','roof')]
pins={'schema':1,'classification':'exploratory; no formal scores','cases':cases,'files':{str(p.relative_to(repo)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for engine in ('a','b') for p in sorted((base/'sources'/(engine+'-v2')).iterdir())},'driver_sha256':hashlib.sha256((base/'run-v2.mjs').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'attempt_budget':{'per_engine':8,'initial_attempts':1,'final_cases':7},'revision_budget':{'per_engine':1,'consumed':True},'limitations':['Exact model ID not exposed','Complete authentic visible author transcript export unavailable','Independent blind judgments and independent edit checks pending']}
(base/'v2-batch-pins.json').write_text(json.dumps(pins,indent=2)+'\n')
env=os.environ.copy();env['APERTURE_WEBGPU_RUNTIME']=str(repo/'.aperture-env/render-runtime')
failed=set();results=[]
for index,(view,edit) in enumerate(cases,2):
 for engine in ('a','b'):
  attempt='attempt-'+str(index).zfill(3)
  if engine in failed:
   results.append({'engine':engine,'attempt':attempt,'view':view,'edit':edit,'status':'unrun-after-failure'});continue
  free=shutil.disk_usage('/workspace/scratch/0190a8c72f8a/aperture-tmp').free
  print(json.dumps({'engine':engine,'attempt':attempt,'free_bytes_before':free}),flush=True)
  if free<2147483648:raise RuntimeError('Low disk; all remaining renders preserved/unrun')
  cmd=['python3','-B','tools/recovery/runtime_pressure.py','--root','/workspace/scratch/0190a8c72f8a/aperture-tmp','--audit-dir',str(base/'lifecycle-audits'),'run','--job','cottage-'+engine+'-'+attempt,'--recreation','Render pinned v2 source through the immutable approved harness','--','node',str(base/'run-v2.mjs'),engine,attempt,view,edit,'v2']
  with (base/(engine+'-'+attempt+'.log')).open('xb') as log:
   proc=subprocess.Popen(cmd,env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
   for line in proc.stdout:
    log.write(line);log.flush();sys.stdout.buffer.write(line);sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
   code=proc.wait()
  results.append({'engine':engine,'attempt':attempt,'view':view,'edit':edit,'exit_code':code,'status':'passed' if code==0 else 'failed'})
  if code:failed.add(engine)
  (base/'v2-batch-progress.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'batch_results':results,'free_bytes_after':shutil.disk_usage('/workspace/scratch/0190a8c72f8a/aperture-tmp').free}),flush=True)
